local function num(v)
	if v ~= v then return "(0/0)" end
	if v == math.huge then return "math.huge" end
	if v == -math.huge then return "-math.huge" end
	return ("%.17g"):format(v)
end

local function emitVal(v)
	local t = typeof(v)
	if t == "number" then return num(v) end
	if t == "boolean" then return tostring(v) end
	if t == "string" then return ("%q"):format(v) end
	if t == "EnumItem" then return tostring(v) end
	if t == "BrickColor" then return ('BrickColor.new("%s")'):format(v.Name) end
	if t == "Vector3" then return ("Vector3.new(%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.X), num(v.Y), num(v.Z)) end
	if t == "Vector2" then return ("Vector2.new(%s,%s)"):format(num(v.X), num(v.Y)) end
	if t == "Color3" then return ("Color3.new(%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.R), num(v.G), num(v.B)) end
	if t == "UDim2" then return ("UDim2.new(%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.X.Scale), num(v.X.Offset), num(v.Y.Scale), num(v.Y.Offset)) end
	if t == "UDim" then return ("UDim.new(%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Scale), num(v.Offset)) end
	if t == "CFrame" then
		local x,y,z,r00,r01,r02,r10,r11,r12,r20,r21,r22 = v:GetComponents()
		return ("CFrame.new(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(x),num(y),num(z),num(r00),num(r01),num(r02),num(r10),num(r11),num(r12),num(r20),num(r21),num(r22))
	end
	if t == "NumberRange" then return ("NumberRange.new(%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Min), num(v.Max)) end
	if t == "NumberSequence" then
		local p = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(v.Keypoints) do p[#p+1] = ("NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(k.Time), num(k.Value), num(k.Envelope)) end
		return "NumberSequence.new({" .. table.concat(p, ",") .. "})"
	end
	if t == "ColorSequence" then
		local p = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(v.Keypoints) do p[#p+1] = ("ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(%s,Color3.new(%s,%s,%s))"):format(num(k.Time), num(k.Value.R), num(k.Value.G), num(k.Value.B)) end
		return "ColorSequence.new({" .. table.concat(p, ",") .. "})"
	end
	if t == "PhysicalProperties" then return ("PhysicalProperties.new(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Density), num(v.Friction), num(v.Elasticity), num(v.FrictionWeight), num(v.ElasticityWeight)) end
	if t == "Rect" then return ("Rect.new(%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Min.X), num(v.Min.Y), num(v.Max.X), num(v.Max.Y)) end
	if t == "Font" then return ('Font.new(%q,%s,%s)'):format(v.Family, tostring(v.Weight), tostring(v.Style)) end
	return nil
end

local function isValidMeshId(id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" then return false end
	local t = id:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if t == "" or t == "0" or t == "rbxassetid://0" or t == "rbxassetid://" or t == "rbxasset://" then return false end
	local l = t:lower()
	if l == "none" or l == "null" or l:find("meshpartfallback") then return false end
	return true
end

local function readMeshId(o)
	local ok, v = pcall(function() return o.MeshId end)
	if ok and isValidMeshId(v) then return v end
	local ok2, c = pcall(function() return o.MeshContent end)
	if ok2 and c then
		local ok3, uri = pcall(function() return c.Uri end)
		if ok3 and isValidMeshId(uri) then return uri end
		local s = tostring(c)
		if (s:match("^rbxasset") or s:match("^http")) and isValidMeshId(s) then return s end
	end
	return nil
end

local function propListFor(c)
	local l, seen = {}, {}
	local function add(k) if not seen[k] then seen[k] = true; l[#l+1] = k end end
	if PART_LIKE[c] or c == "Part" then for _, k in ipairs(prup) do add(k) end end
	if x_prup[c] then for _, k in ipairs(x_prup[c]) do add(k) end end
	for k in pairs(ref_prup) do add(k) end
	return l
end

local function captureActiveAnimations(root)
	local active = {}
	local hum = root:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or root:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
	if hum then
		local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if animator then
			local ok, tracks = pcall(function() return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() end)
			if ok and tracks and #tracks > 0 then
				for _, trk in ipairs(tracks) do
					if trk.IsPlaying and trk.Animation then
						table.insert(active, {
							id = trk.Animation.AnimationId,
							name = trk.Animation.Name,
							speed = trk.Speed,
							weight = trk.WeightCurrent,
							timePos = trk.TimePosition,
							looped = trk.Looped,
							priority = trk.Priority.Name
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if #active == 0 then
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Animation") and (d.Name:lower():find("idle") or (d.Parent and d.Parent.Name:lower():find("idle"))) then
				table.insert(active, {
					id = d.AnimationId,
					name = d.Name,
					speed = 1,
					weight = 1,
					timePos = 0,
					looped = true,
					priority = "Idle"
				})
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return active
end

local function serializeSelection(sel)
	local set, roots = {}, {}
	for _, o in ipairs(sel) do set[o] = true end
	for _, o in ipairs(sel) do
		local p, isRoot = o.Parent, true
		while p do if set[p] then isRoot = false; break end; p = p.Parent end
		if isRoot then roots[#roots+1] = o end
	end
	if #roots == 0 then return nil end
	local root, records, index = roots[1], {}, {}

	local activeAnims = captureActiveAnimations(root)

	local function walk(o, pIdx)
		local c = CLASS_CONV[o.ClassName] or o.ClassName
		if SKIP_CLASSES[c] then return end

		local isScript = (c == "Script" or c == "LocalScript" or c == "ModuleScript")
		local isMP = (c == "MeshPart") or (pcall(function() return o:IsA("MeshPart") end) and o:IsA("MeshPart"))
		local mId = nil
		if isMP then
			c = "MeshPart"
			mId = readMeshId(o)
		end

		local rec = {c = c, n = o.Name, p = pIdx, props = {}, refs = {}}
		records[#records+1] = rec
		local myIdx = #records
		index[o] = myIdx

		if isMP and mId then rec.mesh = mId end

		for _, k in ipairs(propListFor(c)) do
			local ok, v = pcall(function() return o[k] end)
			if ok and v ~= nil then
				if typeof(v) == "Instance" then
					if ref_prup[k] then rec.refs[k] = v end
				else
					local ev = emitVal(v)
					if ev then rec.props[k] = ev end
				end
			end
		end

		if isScript then
			local okS, src = pcall(function() return o.Source end)
			if okS and src then rec.props["Source"] = ("%q"):format(src) end
		end

		local okA, attrs = pcall(function() return o:GetAttributes() end)
		if okA and type(attrs) == "table" then
			for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
				local ev = emitVal(v)
				if ev then rec.attrs = rec.attrs or {}; rec.attrs[k] = ev end
			end
		end

		if c == "Animation" and o.AnimationId and o.AnimationId ~= "" then
			pcall(function()
				local kfs = KeyframeSequenceProvider:GetKeyframeSequenceAsync(o.AnimationId)
				if kfs and kfs:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
					walk(kfs, myIdx)
				end
			end)
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do walk(child, myIdx) end
	end

	walk(root, 0)

	for o, i in pairs(index) do
		for k, target in pairs(records[i].refs) do records[i].refs[k] = index[target] end
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(records) do
		for k in pairs(r.refs) do if type(r.refs[k]) ~= "number" then r.refs[k] = nil end end
		if next(r.refs) == nil then r.refs = nil end
		if next(r.props) == nil then r.props = nil end
	end
	return records, root.Name, #records, activeAnims
end

local function generateCode(name, records, anchorMode, playAnims, activeAnims)
	local animLines = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(activeAnims) do
		animLines[#animLines + 1] = ('\t{ id = %q, name = %q, speed = %s, weight = %s, timePos = %s, looped = %s, priority = %q },'):format(
			a.id, a.name, num(a.speed), num(a.weight), num(a.timePos), tostring(a.looped), a.priority
		)
	end

	local lines = {
		"local CONFIG = {",
		('\tNAME            = %q,'):format(name),
		"\tOFFSET          = CFrame.new(0, 0, -6),",
		('\tANCHOR_MODE     = %q,'):format(anchorMode),
		('\tPLAY_ANIMATIONS = %s,'):format(tostring(playAnims)),
		"\tREPLACE         = true,",
		"}",
		"",
		"local ACTIVE_ANIMS = {",
		table.concat(animLines, "\n"),
		"}",
		"",
		"local DATA = {"
	}

	for _, r in ipairs(records) do
		local p = {('c=%q'):format(r.c), ('n=%q'):format(r.n), ('p=%d'):format(r.p)}
		if r.mesh then p[#p+1] = ('mesh=%q'):format(r.mesh) end
		if r.props then
			local pl = {}
			for k, v in pairs(r.props) do pl[#pl+1] = ("%s=%s"):format(k, v) end
			table.sort(pl)
			p[#p+1] = "props={" .. table.concat(pl, ",") .. "}"
		end
		if r.refs then
			local rl = {}
			for k, idx in pairs(r.refs) do rl[#rl+1] = ("%s=%d"):format(k, idx) end
			table.sort(rl)
			p[#p+1] = "refs={" .. table.concat(rl, ",") .. "}"
		end
		if r.attrs then
			local al = {}
			for k, v in pairs(r.attrs) do al[#al+1] = ("[%q]=%s"):format(k, v) end
			table.sort(al)
			p[#p+1] = "attrs={" .. table.concat(al, ",") .. "}"
		end
		lines[#lines+1] = "\t{ " .. table.concat(p, ", ") .. " },"
	end
	lines[#lines+1] = "}\n"
	return table.concat(lines, "\n") .. RUNTIME
end

	local function updateSel()
		local sel = Selection:Get()
		if #sel == 0 then
			selLbl.Text = " SEL: NONE"
		else
			local f = sel[1]
			selLbl.Text = (" SEL: %s [%s]"):format(f.Name, f.ClassName)
			if nameInp.Text == "" or nameInp.Text == lastSelName then
				lastSelName = f.Name
				nameInp.Text = f.Name
			end

	end

	expBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

		local sel = Selection:Get()

		if not recs or count == 0 then statLbl.Text = " ERR: NO VALID SELECTION"; return end

		local expName = nameInp.Text ~= "" and nameInp.Text or rootName
		expName = expName:gsub('[^%w%-_]', '')
		local code = generateCode(expName, recs, anchorMode, playAnims, activeAnims)

			end)
			updated = true
		end)

		end

local function Create(instance, parent, props)
  local new = Instance.new(instance)
  if props then
    for prop, value in pairs(props) do
      new[prop] = value
    end
  end
  new.Parent = parent
  return new
end

local function SetProps(instance, props)
  if instance and props then
    for prop, value in pairs(props) do
      instance[prop] = value
    end
  end
  return instance
end

local function Corner(parent, props)
  local new = Create("UICorner", parent)
  new.CornerRadius = Configs_HUB.Corner_Radius
  if props then SetProps(new, props) end
  return new
end

local function Stroke(parent, props)
  local new = Create("UIStroke", parent)
  new.Color = Configs_HUB.Cor_Stroke
  new.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  new.Thickness = 2
  
  local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
  }
  gradient.Rotation = 0
  gradient.Parent = new
  
  coroutine.wrap(function()
    while new.Parent do
      gradient.Rotation = (gradient.Rotation + 2) % 360
      RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
    end
  end)()
  
  if props then SetProps(new, props) end
  return new
end

local function BindClick(button, callback)
    button.Activated:Connect(function()
        callback()
    end)
end

local function CreateTween(instance, prop, value, time, tweenWait)
  local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, TweenInfo.new(time, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {[prop] = value})
  tween:Play()
  if tweenWait then tween.Completed:Wait() end
end

local function MakeDraggable(gui)
  local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
  gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragging = true
      dragStart = input.Position
      startPos = gui.Position

      input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
      end)
    end
  end)

  gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragInput = input
    end
  end)

  UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
      local delta = input.Position - dragStart
      gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
  end)
end

local function GetPlayerByString(str)
    if not str or str == "" then return nil end
    str = str:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower()
    
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local name = plr.Name:lower()
        local displayName = plr.DisplayName:lower()
        if string.find(name, str, 1, true) or string.find(displayName, str, 1, true) then
            return plr
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Freecam Script for Roblox (Persistent Executor Version)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Variables to keep track of current character state
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

local freecamEnabled = false
local speed = 240 -- Camera movement speed
local sensitivity = 0.6 -- Mouse sensitivity

-- Store original settings
local originalWalkSpeed = humanoid and humanoid.WalkSpeed or 16
local originalJumpPower = humanoid and humanoid.JumpPower or 50

-- Camera rotation variables
local rotationX = 0
local rotationY = 0

-- Movement keys
local keys = {
    W = false,
    A = false,
    S = false,
    D = false,
    Q = false, -- Down
    E = false, -- Up
    LeftShift = false -- Speed boost
}

-- Function to safely reset camera
local function resetCameraToDefault()
    Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    
    local currentHumanoid = character or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    if currentHumanoid then
        Camera.CameraSubject = currentHumanoid
    end
    
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
    
    if character and character.Parent then
        local currentRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local currentHumanoidObj = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if currentRoot then currentRoot.Anchored = false end
        if currentHumanoidObj then
            currentHumanoidObj.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed or 16
            currentHumanoidObj.JumpPower = originalJumpPower or 50
        end
    end
    
    for key, _ in pairs(keys) do
        keys[key] = false
    end
    
    freecamEnabled = false
end

-- Function to enable freecam
local function enableFreecam()
    if not character or not character.Parent then return end
    
    freecamEnabled = true
    Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
    
    local x, y, z = Camera.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    rotationX = x
    rotationY = y
    
    local currentRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local currentHumanoidObj = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if currentRoot then currentRoot.Anchored = true end
    if currentHumanoidObj then
        currentHumanoidObj.WalkSpeed = 0
        currentHumanoidObj.JumpPower = 0
    end
end

-- Track key presses
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        if freecamEnabled then
            resetCameraToDefault()
        else
            enableFreecam()
        end
    end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R and input:IsModifierKeyDown(Enum.ModifierKey.Ctrl) then
        resetCameraToDefault()
        print("Emergency camera reset activated!")
    end
    
    if freecamEnabled and keys[input.KeyCode.Name] ~= nil then
        keys[input.KeyCode.Name] = true
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if keys[input.KeyCode.Name] ~= nil then
        keys[input.KeyCode.Name] = false
    end
end)

-- Mouse movement for camera rotation
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not freecamEnabled then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local delta = input.Delta
        rotationY = rotationY - delta.X * sensitivity * 0.01
        rotationX = rotationX - delta.Y * sensitivity * 0.01
        rotationX = math.clamp(rotationX, -math.pi/2 + 0.01, math.pi/2 - 0.01)
    end
end)

-- Update camera position
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not freecamEnabled then return end
    
    if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
    end
    
    local movementSpeed = speed
    if keys.LeftShift then
        movementSpeed = speed * 2
    end
    
    local cameraRotation = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(rotationX, rotationY, 0)
    local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    if keys.W then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1)).Position end
    if keys.S then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1)).Position end
    if keys.A then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(-1, 0, 0)).Position end
    if keys.D then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(1, 0, 0)).Position end
    if keys.E then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if keys.Q then moveVector = moveVector - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    
    if moveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
        moveVector = moveVector.Unit
    end
    
    local newPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position + moveVector * movementSpeed * deltaTime
    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPosition) * cameraRotation
end)

-- CRITICAL FIX: Automatically update variables when you respawn, without breaking the script loops
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    freecamEnabled = false
    character = newCharacter
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
    
    if humanoid then
        originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
        originalJumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
    end
end)

local function PDDUG_fake_script() -- Frame.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local frame = script.Parent
	local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	local dragging = false
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	local function update(input)
		if not dragging then return end
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	
	userInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput then
			update(input)
		end
	end)
	
end
coroutine.wrap(PDDUG_fake_script)()

scripts.title: Menu Gui
scripts.script:
local maxDistance = 25
local maxHeightDiff = 10
local scanInterval = 0.2

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser") 
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local AutoFaceEnabled = false
local BoostFPSEnabled = false
local FullBrightEnabled = false
local ESPProwlerEnabled = false
local InteractivityESPEnabled = false 
local NoclipEnabled = false 
local ShiftLockEnabled = false
local CustomWalkSpeed = 17

local GuiVisible = true
local closestTarget = nil

local origAmbient = Lighting.Ambient
local origOutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
local origBrightness = Lighting.Brightness
local origClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime
local origFogColor = Lighting.FogColor
local origFogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
local origFogStart = Lighting.FogStart

local activeHighlights = {}
local activeInteractESP = {} 

local cameraX = 0
local cameraY = 0
local sensitivity = 0.5
local smoothCameraCFrame = CFrame.new()

local randomAngleOffset = 0 

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "OELightCenteredStatusGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local StatusContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
StatusContainer.Name = "StatusContainer"
StatusContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 1, 0)
StatusContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.15, 0) 
StatusContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
StatusContainer.Parent = ScreenGui

local StatusGrid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
StatusGrid.Parent = StatusContainer
StatusGrid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
StatusGrid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
StatusGrid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
StatusGrid.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
StatusGrid.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

local function createStatusTag(text, layoutOrder)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50) 
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
    btn.Parent = StatusContainer
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    return btn
end

local FaceTag = createStatusTag("Auto Face [J]", 1)
local ProwlerTag = createStatusTag("ESP Prowler [P]", 2)
local InteractTag = createStatusTag("ESP Interact [L]", 3)
local NoclipTag = createStatusTag("Noclip [N]", 4)
local FullBrightTag = createStatusTag("Full Bright", 5)
local ShiftLockTag = createStatusTag("ShiftLock [Shift]", 6)
local BoostFPSTag = createStatusTag("Boost FPS", 7)

local ToggleGuiButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleGuiButton.Name = "ToggleGuiButton"
ToggleGuiButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
ToggleGuiButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0.8, 0)
ToggleGuiButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
ToggleGuiButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleGuiButton.Text = "Ctrl"
ToggleGuiButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleGuiButton.TextSize = 20
ToggleGuiButton.Parent = ScreenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", ToggleGuiButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local function toggleGui()
    GuiVisible = not GuiVisible
    StatusContainer.Visible = GuiVisible
    ToggleGuiButton.BackgroundColor3 = GuiVisible and Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 40, 40)
end
ToggleGuiButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

local function updateTagVisuals()
    ProwlerTag.BackgroundColor3 = ESPProwlerEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
    InteractTag.BackgroundColor3 = InteractivityESPEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
    NoclipTag.BackgroundColor3 = NoclipEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
    ShiftLockTag.BackgroundColor3 = ShiftLockEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
    FaceTag.BackgroundColor3 = AutoFaceEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
    BoostFPSTag.BackgroundColor3 = BoostFPSEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
    FullBrightTag.BackgroundColor3 = FullBrightEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
end

local function applyESP(model, color)
    if not model or activeHighlights[model] then return end
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "CustomESP"
    highlight.FillColor = color
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.6
    highlight.OutlineColor = color
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.Adornee = model
    highlight.Parent = model
    activeHighlights[model] = {Object = highlight, Color = color}
end

local function removeESP(model)
    if activeHighlights[model] then
        if activeHighlights[model].Object then activeHighlights[model].Object:Destroy() end
        activeHighlights[model] = nil
    end
end

local function applyInteractESP(part)
    if activeInteractESP[part] then return end
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "InteractESP"
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100) 
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.Adornee = part
    highlight.Parent = part
    activeInteractESP[part] = highlight
end

local function removeInteractESP(part)
    if activeInteractESP[part] then
        activeInteractESP[part]:Destroy()
        activeInteractESP[part] = nil
    end
end

local function updateInteractESPVisibility()
    if not InteractivityESPEnabled then
        for part, _ in pairs(activeInteractESP) do removeInteractESP(part) end
        return
    end
    for _, descendant in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and descendant.KeyboardKeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
            local targetPart = descendant.Parent
            if targetPart and (targetPart:IsA("BasePart") or targetPart:IsA("Model")) then
                applyInteractESP(targetPart)
            end
        end
    end
end

ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt)
    if InteractivityESPEnabled and prompt.KeyboardKeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
        local targetPart = prompt.Parent
        if targetPart and (targetPart:IsA("BasePart") or targetPart:IsA("Model")) then
            applyInteractESP(targetPart)
        end
    end
end)

local function checkAndApplyESP(obj)
    if not obj:IsA("Model") then return end
    local nameLower = string.lower(obj.Name)
    if ESPProwlerEnabled and string.find(nameLower, "prowler") then
        applyESP(obj, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)) 
    end
end

local function updateESPVisibility()
    if not ESPProwlerEnabled then
        for model, _ in pairs(activeHighlights) do removeESP(model) end
        return
    end
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        checkAndApplyESP(obj)
        for _, subObj in pairs(obj:GetChildren()) do checkAndApplyESP(subObj) end
    end
end

workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(descendant)
    removeESP(descendant)
    removeInteractESP(descendant)
end)

local isOptimizing = false

local function isCreature(model)
    if not model:IsA("Model") then return false end
    if model == LocalPlayer.Character then return false end
    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return false end
    return model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil
end

local function optimizeCreature(model)
    if not model then return end

    for _, item in pairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Accessory") or item:IsA("Clothing") or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or item:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
            item:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function optimizeExistingCreatures()
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if isCreature(obj) then
            optimizeCreature(obj)
        end
    end
end

local function enforceFullBrightSettings()
    Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Lighting.Brightness = 2
    Lighting.ClockTime = 14
    Lighting.FogEnd = 999999
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
end

local function updateFullBright()
    if FullBrightEnabled then
        enforceFullBrightSettings()
    else
        Lighting.Ambient = origAmbient
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = origOutdoorAmbient
        Lighting.Brightness = origBrightness
        Lighting.ClockTime = origClockTime
        Lighting.FogColor = origFogColor
        Lighting.FogEnd = origFogEnd
        Lighting.FogStart = origFogStart
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
    end
end

local function updateBoostFPS()
    if BoostFPSEnabled then
        isOptimizing = true
        task.spawn(optimizeExistingCreatures)
    else
        isOptimizing = false
    end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
    if descendant.Parent == workspace or (descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Parent == workspace) then
        checkAndApplyESP(descendant)
    end
    if BoostFPSEnabled then
        task.wait(0.05)
        if isCreature(descendant) then
            optimizeCreature(descendant)
        end
    end
end)

local function toggleNoclip()
    NoclipEnabled = not NoclipEnabled
    updateTagVisuals()
end

local function toggleFakeShiftLock()
    ShiftLockEnabled = not ShiftLockEnabled
    if ShiftLockEnabled then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if camera and rootPart then
            local _, y, _ = rootPart.CFrame:ToOrientation()
            cameraX = math.deg(y)
            cameraY = 0
            smoothCameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
        end
    else
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    end
    updateTagVisuals()
end

local function toggleAutoFace()
    AutoFaceEnabled = not AutoFaceEnabled
    if not AutoFaceEnabled then closestTarget = nil end
    updateTagVisuals()
end

local function toggleBoostFPS()
    BoostFPSEnabled = not BoostFPSEnabled
    updateBoostFPS()
    updateTagVisuals()
end

local function toggleFullBright()
    FullBrightEnabled = not FullBrightEnabled
    updateFullBright()
    updateTagVisuals()
end

local function toggleProwler()
    ESPProwlerEnabled = not ESPProwlerEnabled
    updateESPVisibility()
    updateTagVisuals()
end

local function toggleInteract()
    InteractivityESPEnabled = not InteractivityESPEnabled
    updateInteractESPVisibility()
    updateTagVisuals()
end

ProwlerTag.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleProwler)
InteractTag.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleInteract)
NoclipTag.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleNoclip)
ShiftLockTag.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFakeShiftLock)
FaceTag.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleAutoFace)
BoostFPSTag.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleBoostFPS)
FullBrightTag.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFullBright)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    local code = input.KeyCode
    if code == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or code == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then 
        toggleGui()
    elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.N then 
        toggleNoclip()
    elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then 
        toggleFakeShiftLock()
    elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.J then
        toggleAutoFace()
    elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.P then
        toggleProwler()
    elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.L then
        toggleInteract()
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not ShiftLockEnabled then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local delta = input.Delta
        cameraX = cameraX - (delta.X * sensitivity)
        cameraY = cameraY - (delta.Y * sensitivity)
        cameraY = math.clamp(cameraY, -80, 80)
    end
end)

local function isValidTarget(obj)
    if not obj then return false end
    local humanoid = obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    if obj == LocalPlayer.Character then return false end
    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then return false end
    
    if humanoid.Health > 50000 or (humanoid.Health == 100 and humanoid.MaxHealth == 100) then
        return false
    end
    
    return true
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local myRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            if hum.WalkSpeed ~= CustomWalkSpeed then hum.WalkSpeed = CustomWalkSpeed end
        end
        
        if NoclipEnabled then
            for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if FullBrightEnabled then
        enforceFullBrightSettings()
    end

    if AutoFaceEnabled and closestTarget and myRoot then
        local targetRoot = closestTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or closestTarget:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if targetRoot then
            local myPos = myRoot.Position
            local rawTargetPos = Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X, myRoot.Position.Y, targetRoot.Position.Z)
            
            local direction = (rawTargetPos - myPos).Unit
            local rotatedDirection = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(randomAngleOffset), 0) * direction
            local finalTargetPos = myPos + rotatedDirection * (myPos - rawTargetPos).Magnitude
            
            local targetCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, finalTargetPos)
            myRoot.CFrame = myRoot.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, 0.22)
        end
    end
    
    if ShiftLockEnabled and camera then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        if myRoot then
            local targetOffset = Vector3.new(1.7, 2, 20) 
            local startCFrame = CFrame.new(myRoot.Position)
            local rotationCFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(cameraX), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(cameraY), 0, 0)
            local idealCameraCFrame = startCFrame * rotationCFrame * CFrame.new(targetOffset)
            
            local rayStart = myRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, targetOffset.Y, 0)
            local rayEnd = idealCameraCFrame.Position
            local rayDirection = rayEnd - rayStart
            
            local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            local filterList = {char, camera}
            for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.Character then table.insert(filterList, p.Character) end
            end
            raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterList
            
            local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(rayStart, rayDirection, raycastParams)
            local targetCFrame = idealCameraCFrame
            if raycastResult then
                local hitPosition = raycastResult.Position
                local safeDirection = (hitPosition - rayStart).Unit
                local safeDistance = (hitPosition - rayStart).Magnitude - 0.5
                if safeDistance < 1 then safeDistance = 1 end
                local safeCameraPos = rayStart + (safeDirection * safeDistance)
                targetCFrame = CFrame.new(safeCameraPos) * rotationCFrame
            end
            
            smoothCameraCFrame = smoothCameraCFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, 0.25)
            camera.CFrame = smoothCameraCFrame
        end
    end
end)

    for i = 1, 3 do

scripts.script:
-- XploitHub.lua -- merged ESP + Aimbot with XPLOIT-style clean UI
-- ESP: Boxes / Tracers / Names / Distance / Health / Chams (Highlight)
-- Aim: hold-RMB camera lock with FOV + silent-aim helper for YOUR OWN tools
-- Use only in your own games / Studio testing. Live exploiting = ban.
-- Execute: copy entire file into executor -> Execute

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
assert(LocalPlayer, "[XPLOIT] No LocalPlayer - run as client")
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

local Settings = {
    -- ESP
    ESPEnabled = true,
    Boxes = true,
    Tracers = false,
    Names = true,
    Distance = true,
    HealthBar = true,
    HealthText = false,
    Chams = true,
    -- Aim
    AimbotEnabled = false, -- hold RMB to lock
    SilentAimEnabled = false,
    ShowFOV = true,
    WallCheck = true,
    -- Shared
    TeamCheck = true,
    ShowTeamColors = true,
    FOV = 120,
    Smoothing = 8,
    TargetPart = "Head", -- Head | HumanoidRootPart | Closest
    Prediction = 0,      -- 0 .. 0.30
    SilentHitChance = 100,
    MaxDistance = 2000,  -- 0 = infinite
    AimKey = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
    BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
    FriendlyColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 100),
}

local hasDrawing = typeof(Drawing) == "table" and typeof(Drawing.new) == "function"
local RED = Color3.fromRGB(220, 45, 55)
local BG = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
local PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 32)
local DIM = Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 190)
local BRIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)

--// parent
local function getParent()
    local ok, h = pcall(function()
        if typeof(gethui) == "function" then return gethui() end
        if typeof(get_hidden_gui) == "function" then return get_hidden_gui() end
        return nil
    end)
    if ok and h then return h end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
end
local Parent = getParent()
assert(Parent, "[XPLOIT] no parent GUI found")
pcall(function() Parent:FindFirstChild("XploitHub"):Destroy() end)

local function new(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end
    o.Parent = parent
    return o
end

local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "XploitHub", ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 999,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
}, Parent)
if typeof(protect_gui) == "function" then pcall(protect_gui, gui) end

--// main window (XPLOIT look: dark, red title, 2 columns)
local main = new("Frame", {
    Name = "Main", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(440, 430),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -220, 0.5, -215),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG, Active = true,
}, gui)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) }, main)
new("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 20, 25), Transparency = 0.1 }, main)

local titleBar = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, main)
local title = new("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "XPLOIT", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 15,
    TextColor3 = RED,
}, titleBar)
new("Frame", { -- red divider under title
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 33),
    BackgroundColor3 = RED, BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
}, titleBar)
local minBtn = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 22), Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 6),
    BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, Text = "-", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14,
    TextColor3 = BRIGHT, AutoButtonColor = true,
}, titleBar)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, minBtn)

local cols = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -88), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 40),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, main)
local left = new("ScrollingFrame", {
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ScrollBarThickness = 3, AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
    CanvasSize = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
}, cols)
new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, left)
new("UIPadding", { PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6) }, left)
local right = new("ScrollingFrame", {
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    ScrollBarThickness = 3, AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
    CanvasSize = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
}, cols)
new("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, right)
new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6) }, right)

local footer = new("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 40), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -46),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, main)
local unloadBtn = new("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.62), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 25, 30),
    Text = "Unload", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,
    TextColor3 = BRIGHT, AutoButtonColor = true,
}, footer)
new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, unloadBtn)
local hint = new("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.66),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "RightShift: UI  |  RMB hold: aim  |  Q: silent  |  Del: unload",
    Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = DIM,
}, footer)

--// builders (match screenshot: red section header, dot toggles, - value + steppers)
local function section(parent, text)
    local s = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextColor3 = RED,
    }, parent)
    new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = RED, BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 0.6,
    }, s)
    return s
end

local function refreshToggle(btn, dot, label, on)
    btn.Text = "  •  " .. label
    dot.BackgroundColor3 = on and RED or Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 85)
end

local function toggle(parent, label, key)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextColor3 = BRIGHT, AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, parent)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, b)
    local dot = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, -3),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 85), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, b)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }, dot)
    refreshToggle(b, dot, label, Settings[key])
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Settings[key] = not Settings[key]
        refreshToggle(b, dot, label, Settings[key])
    end)
    return b
end

local function slider(parent, label, key, smin, smax, step, fmt)
    fmt = fmt or function(v) return tostring(v) end
    local row = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL,
    }, parent)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, row)
    new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "  •  " .. label,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = BRIGHT,
    }, row)
    local minus = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0.5, -8),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 52), Text = "-",
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = BRIGHT,
        AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, row)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }, minus)
    local val = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0.5, -8),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = fmt(Settings[key]),
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = RED,
    }, row)
    local plus = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -8),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 52), Text = "+",
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = BRIGHT,
        AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, row)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }, plus)
    local function set(v)
        v = math.clamp(math.floor(v / step + 0.5) * step, smin, smax)
        -- Prediction uses decimals, don't snap harshly
        if step < 1 then v = math.clamp(v, smin, smax) end
        Settings[key] = v
        val.Text = fmt(v)
    end
    minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(Settings[key] - step) end)
    plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(Settings[key] + step) end)
    return row
end

local function cycle(parent, label, key, options)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextColor3 = BRIGHT, AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, parent)
    new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }, b)
    local function paint()
        b.Text = "  •  " .. label .. ":  " .. tostring(Settings[key])
    end
    paint()
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local idx = 1
        for i, o in ipairs(options) do if o == Settings[key] then idx = i break end end
        Settings[key] = options[(idx % #options) + 1]
        paint()
    end)
    return b
end

-- LEFT column (like screenshot left side)
section(left, "ESP")
toggle(left, "Enabled", "ESPEnabled")
toggle(left, "Boxes", "Boxes")
toggle(left, "Tracers", "Tracers")
toggle(left, "Names", "Names")
toggle(left, "Distance", "Distance")
toggle(left, "Health bar", "HealthBar")
toggle(left, "Health text", "HealthText")
toggle(left, "Chams", "Chams")

section(left, "AIM")
toggle(left, "Aimbot (hold RMB)", "AimbotEnabled")
toggle(left, "Silent aim", "SilentAimEnabled")

toggle(left, "Wall check", "WallCheck")

-- RIGHT column (like screenshot right side)
section(right, "AIM TUNE")
slider(right, "FOV", "FOV", 30, 400, 5, function(v) return tostring(math.floor(v)) end)
slider(right, "Smooth", "Smoothing", 1, 20, 1, function(v) return tostring(math.floor(v)) end)
cycle(right, "Bone", "TargetPart", { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "Closest" })
slider(right, "Predict", "Prediction", 0, 0.3, 0.01, function(v) return string.format("%.2f", v) end)
slider(right, "Hit %", "SilentHitChance", 1, 100, 1, function(v) return tostring(math.floor(v)) end)

section(right, "SETTINGS")
toggle(right, "Team check", "TeamCheck")
toggle(right, "Team colors", "ShowTeamColors")
slider(right, "Max dist", "MaxDistance", 0, 5000, 100, function(v)
    if v == 0 then return "inf" end
    return tostring(math.floor(v))
end)

--// shared targeting logic
local function isFriendly(p)
    if not Settings.TeamCheck then return false end
    local ok, r = pcall(function()
        return LocalPlayer.Team ~= nil and p.Team ~= nil and LocalPlayer.Team == p.Team
    end)
    return ok and r == true
end

local function espColor(p)
    if Settings.ShowTeamColors then
        local ok, c = pcall(function() return p.TeamColor.Color end)
        if ok and c then return c end
    end
    if isFriendly(p) then return Settings.FriendlyColor end
    return Settings.BoxColor
end

local function wallClear(targetPos, targetChar)
    if not Settings.WallCheck then return true end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character, targetChar }
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    return Workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPos - origin, params) == nil
end

local function getTargetPart(char)
    if Settings.TargetPart == "Head" then return char:FindFirstChild("Head") end
    if Settings.TargetPart == "HumanoidRootPart" then return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if head and hrp then
        local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        local hp = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
        local rp = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
        local hd = (Vector2.new(hp.X, hp.Y) - m).Magnitude
        local rd = (Vector2.new(rp.X, rp.Y) - m).Magnitude
        if hd < rd then return head else return hrp end
    end
    return head or hrp
end

local function distToLocal(hrp)
    local my = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not my then return 0 end
    return (hrp.Position - my.Position).Magnitude
end

local function closestTarget()
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then return nil, nil end
    local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local best, bestD, bestPos = nil, Settings.FOV, nil
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p == LocalPlayer or isFriendly(p) then continue end
        local char = p.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
        local part = getTargetPart(char)
        if not part then continue end
        local aimPos = part.Position
        if Settings.Prediction > 0 then
            local ok, vel = pcall(function() return part.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
            if ok and vel then aimPos = aimPos + vel * Settings.Prediction end
        end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and Settings.MaxDistance > 0 and distToLocal(hrp) > Settings.MaxDistance then continue end
        local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(aimPos)
        if not onScreen then continue end
        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mouse).Magnitude
        if d < bestD and wallClear(aimPos, char) then
            best, bestD, bestPos = p, d, aimPos
        end
    end
    return best, bestPos
end

local function silentShouldHit()
    return math.random(1, 100) <= Settings.SilentHitChance
end

-- expose for YOUR OWN tool scripts (silent aim done right: redirect your own ray):
--   local g = getgenv()
--   local target, pos = g.XploitClosestTarget()
--   if target and pos and g.XploitSilentFire() then
--     dir = (pos - origin).Unit * 1000
--   else
--     dir = (mouse.Hit.Position - origin).Unit * 1000
--   end
pcall(function()
    local g = getgenv and getgenv() or nil
    if g then
        g.XploitClosestTarget = closestTarget
        g.XploitSilentFire = function()
            return Settings.SilentAimEnabled and silentShouldHit()
        end
        g.XploitSettings = Settings
    end
end)

--// ESP objects
local espObjects = {}
local function hideDrawings(e)
    if e.drawings then for _, d in pairs(e.drawings) do pcall(function() d.Visible = false end) end end
    if e.fov then pcall(function() e.fov.Visible = false end) end
end
local function clearPlayer(p)
    local e = espObjects[p]
    if not e then return end
    pcall(function() e.highlight:Destroy() end)
    pcall(function() e.billboard:Destroy() end)
    hideDrawings(e)
    if e.drawings then for _, d in pairs(e.drawings) do pcall(function() d:Remove() end) end end
    espObjects[p] = nil
end
local function setupPlayer(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    if espObjects[player] then clearPlayer(player) end
    local e = { drawings = {} }
    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Name = "X_ESP"
    hl.FillTransparency = 0.6
    hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
    hl.Parent = gui
    e.highlight = hl
    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Name = "X_Name"
    bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 40)
    bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
    bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bb.MaxDistance = math.huge
    bb.Parent = gui
    local nl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    nl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nl.TextSize = 13
    nl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    nl.Parent = bb
    e.billboard = bb
    e.nameLabel = nl
    if hasDrawing then
        local box = Drawing.new("Square") box.Thickness = 1 box.Filled = false box.Visible = false box.ZIndex = 2
        local tr = Drawing.new("Line") tr.Thickness = 1 tr.Visible = false tr.ZIndex = 1
        local back = Drawing.new("Square") back.Filled = true back.Visible = false back.ZIndex = 1
        local bar = Drawing.new("Square") bar.Filled = true bar.Visible = false bar.ZIndex = 2
        e.drawings = { box = box, tracer = tr, hpBack = back, hpBar = bar }
    end
    espObjects[player] = e
    local function bind(char)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        local head = char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if hum and hrp then
            e.highlight.Adornee = char
            e.billboard.Adornee = head or hrp
        end
    end
    if player.Character then task.spawn(bind, player.Character) end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.spawn(bind, c) end)
end
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do pcall(setupPlayer, p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clearPlayer)

-- FOV ring
local fovCircle
if hasDrawing then
    fovCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
    fovCircle.Thickness = 1
    fovCircle.NumSides = 64
    fovCircle.Filled = false
    fovCircle.Color = RED
end

--// input: RightShift = UI, Q = silent, Del = unload, RMB hold = aim
local aiming = false
local conns = {}
local function unload()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(conns)
    for p, _ in pairs(espObjects) do pcall(clearPlayer, p) end
    if fovCircle then pcall(function() fovCircle:Remove() end) end
    pcall(function()
        local g = getgenv and getgenv() or nil
        if g then g.XploitClosestTarget, g.XploitSilentFire = nil, nil end
    end)
    pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
    print("[XPLOIT] unloaded")
end
unloadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(unload)
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Settings.AimKey then aiming = true end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then Settings.SilentAimEnabled = not Settings.SilentAimEnabled end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then main.Visible = not main.Visible end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then unload() end
end)
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Settings.AimKey then aiming = false end
end)
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() main.Visible = false end)

-- drag
do
    local dragging, sp, si = false, nil, nil
    titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, sp, si = true, main.Position, i.Position
        end
    end)
    titleBar.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if not dragging then return end
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local d = i.Position - si
            main.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + d.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
end

local function tracerFrom()
    local vs = Camera.ViewportSize
    return Vector2.new(vs.X / 2, vs.Y)
end

--// single render loop: ESP + FOV + hard aimbot
conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not gui.Parent then return end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then return end

    if fovCircle then
        fovCircle.Position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        fovCircle.Radius = Settings.FOV
        fovCircle.Visible = Settings.ShowFOV and Settings.AimbotEnabled
    end

    -- hard aimbot (camera lock while held)
    if Settings.AimbotEnabled and aiming then
        local _, pos = closestTarget()
        if pos then
            local cf = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, pos)
            Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(cf, math.clamp(Settings.Smoothing / 20, 0.05, 1))
        end
    end

    -- ESP
    for player, e in pairs(espObjects) do
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local char = player.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local valid = Settings.ESPEnabled and char and hum and hrp and head
                and hum.Health > 0 and not isFriendly(player)
            local dist = 0
            if hrp then dist = distToLocal(hrp) end
            if Settings.MaxDistance > 0 and dist > Settings.MaxDistance then valid = false end
            if not valid then
                e.highlight.Enabled = false
                e.billboard.Enabled = false
                hideDrawings(e)
                return
            end
            local color = espColor(player)
            e.highlight.Enabled = Settings.Chams
            if Settings.Chams then
                e.highlight.Adornee = char
                e.highlight.FillColor = color
                e.highlight.OutlineColor = color
            end
            local showText = Settings.Names or Settings.Distance or Settings.HealthText
            e.billboard.Enabled = showText
            if showText then
                e.billboard.Adornee = head
                local parts = {}
                if Settings.Names then table.insert(parts, player.DisplayName .. " (@" .. player.Name .. ")") end
                if Settings.Distance then table.insert(parts, "[" .. math.floor(dist) .. "m]") end
                if Settings.HealthText then table.insert(parts, math.ceil(hum.Health) .. " HP") end
                e.nameLabel.Text = table.concat(parts, " ")
                e.nameLabel.TextColor3 = color
            end
            if hasDrawing then
                local hp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                local top = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0))
                local bot = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                local h = math.abs(top.Y - bot.Y)
                local w = h * 0.6
                if onScreen and Settings.Boxes then
                    local b = e.drawings.box
                    b.Visible = true b.Color = color
                    b.Size = Vector2.new(w, h)
                    b.Position = Vector2.new(hp.X - w / 2, top.Y)
                else e.drawings.box.Visible = false end
                if onScreen and Settings.Tracers then
                    local t = e.drawings.tracer
                    t.Visible = true t.Color = color
                    t.From = tracerFrom()
                    t.To = Vector2.new(hp.X, bot.Y)
                else e.drawings.tracer.Visible = false end
                if onScreen and Settings.HealthBar then
                    local f = math.clamp(hum.Health / hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                    local bx = hp.X - w / 2 - 5
                    e.drawings.hpBack.Visible = true
                    e.drawings.hpBack.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    e.drawings.hpBack.Position = Vector2.new(bx, top.Y)
                    e.drawings.hpBack.Size = Vector2.new(3, h)
                    e.drawings.hpBar.Visible = true
                    e.drawings.hpBar.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 - math.floor(255 * f), math.floor(255 * f), 40)
                    e.drawings.hpBar.Position = Vector2.new(bx, top.Y + h * (1 - f))
                    e.drawings.hpBar.Size = Vector2.new(3, h * f)
                else
                    e.drawings.hpBack.Visible = false
                    e.drawings.hpBar.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end)
        if not ok then
            pcall(function() e.highlight.Enabled = false e.billboard.Enabled = false end)
            hideDrawings(e)
        end
    end
end)

print("[XPLOIT] loaded. Drawing: " .. tostring(hasDrawing))
